verdict.rationale: Unity documents a public scripting API (unity-docs-11), an extensible Editor API (unity-docs-10/30), a first-party CLI for automation/CI (unity-docs-25/26, unity-probe-rt-4 with structured JSON/exit codes), and an official MCP server bridging LLM agents to the Editor (unity-docs-23/24, unity-probe-4, unity-probe-rt-1), giving AI-native users multiple documented, scriptable entry points into the product. Missing for 10: a machine-readable REST/OpenAPI spec (unity-probe-3 shows 404s across all OpenAPI candidate paths) and llms.txt/markdown mirrors for the actual docs.unity3d.com manual (unity-probe-1/2, confirmed in unity-probe-rt-2), plus the MCP server's closed-source distribution noted in unity-probe-rt-1.
